name: cabina
description: A clean side pane for Claude Code: model, context, rate limits, cost, activity and project at a glance. Themes, light/dark backgrounds and any language.

language.title: Idioma / Language
language.description: auto = Claude Code's language setting; custom = the language typed below

customLanguage.title: Otro idioma / Other language
customLanguage.description: Any language name or code (swahili, català, ja…), used when language is custom

theme.title: Tema / Theme
theme.description: Colours of the bars, the accent and the branch; or /cabina theme <name>

background.title: Fondo / Background
background.description: auto = the terminal's own; dark or light paints the pane, with text to match
